text: Got it — investigating the bug in src/plugin/timezone/index.js (parsing of timestamp / JS Date / Day.js object). ETA ~10 minutes to fix and verify.
Noted — bug #2 (`Convert format Z`, timezone offset formatting) is being diagnosed now; ETA ~12 minutes.
Noted — bug #3 (Dutch locale `Do` ordinal formatting) is being worked on now; ETA ~12 minutes.
Noted — bug #4 (weekYear plugin `yearStart: 4`) is being worked on now; ETA ~12 minutes.
Bug #4 fixed and verified: weekYear plugin now maps early-January dates in week 52/53 to the previous week-year (e.g. 2016-01-01 → 2015, 2021-01-01 → 2020). Full suite passes (57 suites / 525 tests).
Bug #3 fixed and verified: src/locale/nl.js ordinal now returns Dutch `1e, 2e, ... 31e` instead of `1., 2., ...`. Locale suite (13 suites / 168 tests) and full suite (57 suites / 525 tests) pass.
Noted — bug #5 (customParseFormat meridiem with non-English locales) is being worked on now; ETA ~12 minutes.
Noted — bug #6 (duration plugin, `Creating milliseconds`) is being worked on now; ETA ~12 minutes.

Bug #6 fixed and verified: the duration plugin's unit table was missing the `milliseconds` entry, so `dayjs.duration(1500,'ms')` and ms-based add/subtract produced NaN. Added `milliseconds: 1`; duration tests (14/14) and full suite (57 suites / 525 tests) pass.
